STEP 6. Check the sensor output voltage at crankshaft 
position sensor connector B-20.
(1) Disconnect connector B-20 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 2 and ground.
• Voltage should be between 4.8 and 5.2 volts.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Go to Step 7.
